name: SOF lateral spine radiographs (Study of Osteoporotic Fractures)
what: the women's counterpart of MrOS: lateral thoracolumbar films at several visits, about 9,700 women, Genant grading per vertebra; counts to confirm on the page
level_truth: Genant grades on named levels, so level truth exists
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; asked SOF's data team on 2026-10-22 for leave to register; Liezl P. Concepcion (Center for Aging Science, Sutter Health Research Institute) answered the same day that SOF Online is closed to registrations while it is changed for new NIH requirements and will write when it reopens, and that the study images are being moved to the NIA Aging Research Biobank (agingresearchbiobank.nia.nih.gov), to which the image request goes; no request there yet; with MrOS the largest level-labelled lateral spine film resource that exists
licence: an NIA Outgoing Human Data Transfer Agreement signed by the PI and Wayne State's Signing Official: non-profit research on the approved project only, no redistribution, no re-identification, acknowledgement, 12 months renewable, destruction certified at the end
how_to_get: Submit the image request to the NIA Aging Research Biobank (https://agingresearchbiobank.nia.nih.gov), as SOF's data team said on 2026-10-22; SOF Online is closed to registration until SOF writes that it has reopened.
The owner files the request in the owner's name and signs whatever agreement follows; a session drafts the proposal text once the owner asks.
Once granted, fetch by the route the centre gives, as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node.
